name: Create a season
description: Admin only. ONE STATEMENT creates the season -- its NAME and the slug season_slug() derives from it, both fixed for ever (N28), number last+1 as an internal ordinal, the engine pinned from games.active_engine_digest, the window and the whole rules document -- carries every active baseline of the previous season into it at the prior with its seed events, and bumps the roster epoch. Refusals, told apart by `why`: a name that gives no usable slug, a slug another season holds, a season still live, an opening inside season_gap_days of the previous close, or no engine declared. The season opens with NO MAPS: they are uploaded to it afterwards, disabled, and enabled by hand. PARTICIPANT HANDLES ARE STORED AS GIVEN and resolved at each submission, not here: a cohort is a list of GitHub logins written before the term starts and most of its members have never signed in, so resolving once and keeping only the ids would refuse exactly those people for the whole season. The ids that DO resolve are stored beside them as the fast path, and the handles that do not come back in the response as information. The list accepts an array or one comma-separated string. WEIGHT CLASSES ARE THE SEASON'S: absent from the body it inherits the previous season's table rather than a constant, and the carry-forward is filtered by them, so a nano-only season carries the nano baselines and leaves the rest behind instead of seating a `large` version on a ladder that does not exist. The baselines are carried as VERSIONS of the entries they already have -- before an entry was a row of its own the carry had to forge a new one every season.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

body.detail: A season is named when it is created -- "Summer 2026" -- and its slug, summer-2026, is how every link addresses it. Neither can be changed later.
submissions_open_at and submissions_close_at are required, as ISO-8601 timestamps.

input.query: WITH given AS ( SELECT DISTINCT btrim(h) AS handle FROM unnest(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(($1)::jsonb) = 'array' THEN ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(($1)::jsonb)) ELSE regexp_split_to_array(($1)::jsonb #>> '{}', '\s*,\s*') END) AS h WHERE btrim(h) <> '' ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(g.handle ORDER BY g.handle), '[]'::jsonb) AS handles, coalesce(jsonb_agg(u.id::text ORDER BY u.handle) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS ids, coalesce(jsonb_agg(g.handle ORDER BY g.handle) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS unresolved FROM given g LEFT JOIN users u ON lower(u.handle) = lower(g.handle)

tasks.name: Put the handles and the ids the rule
Create the season and carry the baselines

input.query: WITH game AS ( SELECT g.id, g.active_engine_digest FROM games g WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text ), last AS ( SELECT max(s.number) AS number, max(s.closed_at) AS closed_at FROM seasons s JOIN game ON game.id = s.game_id ), created AS ( INSERT INTO seasons (game_id, number, name, slug, engine_digest, submissions_open_at, submissions_close_at, rules, weight_classes) SELECT game.id, coalesce(last.number, 0) + 1, btrim(($9)::text), season_slug(btrim(($9)::text)), game.active_engine_digest, ($2)::timestamptz, ($3)::timestamptz, coalesce(($7)::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), coalesce(($8)::jsonb, (SELECT s.weight_classes FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = game.id ORDER BY s.number DESC LIMIT 1), '[{"class": "nano", "max_bytes": 16384}, {"class": "micro", "max_bytes": 131072}, {"class": "mini", "max_bytes": 1048576}, {"class": "small", "max_bytes": 8388608}, {"class": "large", "max_bytes": 134217728}]'::jsonb) FROM game, last WHERE game.active_engine_digest IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim(($9)::text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 48 AND season_slug(btrim(($9)::text)) ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND char_length(season_slug(btrim(($9)::text))) <= 48 AND season_slug(btrim(($9)::text)) NOT IN ('current', 'live', 'latest', 'new') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = game.id AND s.slug = season_slug(btrim(($9)::text))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = game.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL) AND ($2)::timestamptz >= coalesce(last.closed_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) + make_interval(days => ($4)::int) RETURNING id, number, game_id, weight_classes ), carried AS ( INSERT INTO model_versions (model_id, game_id, season_id, version, status, weight_class, size_bytes, param_count, infer_us, weights_hash, manifest_hash, manifest, orion_version) SELECT b.model_id, b.game_id, created.id, (SELECT max(x.version) FROM model_versions x WHERE x.model_id = b.model_id) + 1, 'active', b.weight_class, b.size_bytes, b.param_count, b.infer_us, b.weights_hash, b.manifest_hash, b.manifest, b.orion_version FROM created JOIN seasons prev ON prev.game_id = created.game_id AND prev.number = created.number - 1 JOIN model_versions b ON b.season_id = prev.id AND b.status = 'active' AND b.weight_class::text IN (SELECT e ->> 'class' FROM created, jsonb_array_elements(created.weight_classes) AS e) JOIN models be ON be.id = b.model_id JOIN users u ON u.id = be.owner_id AND u.role = 'baseline' RETURNING id, weight_class ), seeded AS ( INSERT INTO ratings (version_id, ladder, mu, sigma) SELECT c.id, l.ladder, coalesce((($7)::jsonb -> 'rating' ->> 'prior_mu')::float8, ($5)::float8), coalesce((($7)::jsonb -> 'rating' ->> 'prior_sigma')::float8, ($6)::float8) FROM carried c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (c.weight_class), ('open'::ladder)) AS l (ladder) RETURNING version_id, ladder, mu, sigma ), events AS ( INSERT INTO rating_events (version_id, ladder, seq, mu_after, sigma_after) SELECT version_id, ladder, 0, mu, sigma FROM seeded RETURNING version_id ) UPDATE clocks c SET epoch = c.epoch + 1, updated_at = now() FROM created WHERE c.key = 'roster'

SELECT json_build_object( 'slug', season_slug(btrim(($3)::text)), 'name_usable', char_length(btrim(($3)::text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 48 AND season_slug(btrim(($3)::text)) ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND char_length(season_slug(btrim(($3)::text))) <= 48 AND season_slug(btrim(($3)::text)) NOT IN ('current', 'live', 'latest', 'new'), 'taken_by', (SELECT s.name FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = g.id AND s.slug = season_slug(btrim(($3)::text))), 'live', (SELECT json_build_object('slug', s.slug, 'name', s.name, 'closed_at', s.closed_at) FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL), 'earliest_open', (SELECT max(s.closed_at) + make_interval(days => ($2)::int) FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = g.id), 'engine', g.active_engine_digest IS NOT NULL) AS body FROM games g WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text

body.detail: A name is 1 to 48 characters and must leave a slug -- letters and digits, joined by hyphens -- that is not current, live, latest or new.

with.name: A name that makes a slug

input.query: SELECT season_json(s) AS body FROM games g, current_season(g.id) s WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text
